console.log([10, 9, 1, 100].sort()); // no compare function: sorted as TEXT
console.log([10, 9, 1, 100].sort((a, b) => a - b)); // negative: a first; positive: b first

const guests = [
  { name: 'Ada', table: 2 },
  { name: 'Bo', table: 1 },
  { name: 'Cy', table: 2 },
  { name: 'Di', table: 1 },
];
const byTable = guests.toSorted((a, b) => a.table - b.table);
console.log(byTable.map((g) => `${g.table}:${g.name}`).join(' ')); // ties keep their order
console.log(guests[0].name); // toSorted left the original alone
